update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval, in seconds. Every CloudWatch series is evaluated on these ticks, never on its own timer.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

credentials.title: Credential sources
credentials.description: Named credential sources that targets reference. Each uses the AWS SDK default chain or explicit static credentials.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name that targets use to reference this credential source.

type.title: Type
type.description: How this source obtains AWS credentials: the SDK default chain or explicit static credentials.

type_static.title: Static credential configuration
type_static.description: Explicit AWS credentials, used only when the type is `static`. Prefer secret references over plaintext values.

access_key_id.title: Access key ID
access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID. Use a secret reference such as `${env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}`.

secret_access_key.title: Secret access key
secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key. Use a secret reference instead of a plaintext value.

session_token.title: Session token
session_token.description: AWS session token, only for temporary credentials. Use a secret reference.

targets.title: Monitored targets
targets.description: Named AWS identities to monitor. A target uses one credential source directly or assumes one role with it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name that collection rules use to reference this target.

credentials.title: Credential source
credentials.description: Name of a credential source defined on the Credentials tab.

assume_role.title: Assume role

role_arn.title: Role ARN
role_arn.description: ARN of the IAM role to assume with the target's credential source.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External ID the role's trust policy expects, if it requires one. This is not a password or access key.

assume_role.description: IAM role to assume before collecting this target. Leave empty to use the credential source directly.

rules.title: Collection rules
rules.description: Ordered collection rules. Each selects targets, profiles, regions, and optional metric overrides and resource filters; the first matching rule owns a series.

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique rule name, shown in logs and diagnostics.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Names of the targets this rule collects from, in order. Order breaks ties when rules overlap.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Omit to select default-enabled profiles. Include adds profiles; exclude removes profiles. Higher-cardinality PrivateLink endpoint/service grains are opt-in: privatelink_endpoint_subnet, privatelink_service_az, privatelink_service_load_balancer, privatelink_service_az_load_balancer, and privatelink_service_vpc_endpoint. Billing profiles are also opt-in: billing_total, billing_service, billing_linked_account, and billing_linked_account_service.

defaults.title: Include defaults
defaults.description: Start from every default-enabled profile before applying the include and exclude lists.

include.description: Profile basenames to add. With `defaults` off, only this list is collected, including profiles disabled by default.
include.title: Included profiles

exclude.description: Profile basenames to remove from the selection. A profile cannot be both included and excluded.
exclude.title: Excluded profiles

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Per-profile metric overrides. Leave empty to collect each selected profile's default-enabled metrics.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Profile basename to override. It must be selected by this rule's profiles and may appear in one metrics group only.

defaults.title: Include profile defaults
defaults.description: Keep the profile's default-enabled metrics and add the included ones. Turn off for an exact-only selection.

statistics.title: Default statistics
statistics.description: Statistics for included metrics that do not list their own. Leave empty to use the profile's statistics.

query.title: Included-metric query policy
query.description: Query timing for the series this group includes explicitly. Fields left empty inherit from the rule.

period.title: Aggregation period
period.description: CloudWatch aggregation period for these series, from `1m` to `24h` in whole minutes.

lookback.title: Rolling lookback
lookback.description: Window searched for the newest datapoint. At least one period, a whole multiple of it, and at most 1,440 periods.

publication_delay.title: Publication delay
publication_delay.description: How long to wait after a period closes before querying it. A scheduling policy, not an AWS guarantee.

include.title: Included metrics
include.description: Exact, case-sensitive CloudWatch metric names this group adds. A name may repeat only with disjoint statistics.

name.title: AWS MetricName
name.description: Exact, case-sensitive CloudWatch MetricName exported by the profile.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Statistics for this metric, replacing the group list. Leave empty to inherit. Use `Average`, `Minimum`, `Maximum`, `Sum`, `SampleCount`, or `p<N>`.

query.title: Metric/statistic query policy
query.description: Query timing for this metric's series, overriding the group's. Fields left empty inherit.

period.title: Aggregation period
period.description: CloudWatch aggregation period for these series, from `1m` to `24h` in whole minutes.

lookback.title: Rolling lookback
lookback.description: Window searched for the newest datapoint. At least one period, a whole multiple of it, and at most 1,440 periods.

publication_delay.title: Publication delay
publication_delay.description: How long to wait after a period closes before querying it. A scheduling policy, not an AWS guarantee.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: AWS region codes this rule collects from. Profiles that support fewer regions are restricted automatically.

filters.title: Resource filters
filters.description: Selection predicates for this rule. Omit resource_tags to inherit the job default; set it to an empty list to disable the default for this rule.

resource_tags.title: AWS resource tag filters
resource_tags.description: Resource tag filters replacing the job defaults for this rule. Leave unset to inherit, or set an empty list to disable filtering.

key.title: AWS tag key
key.description: Exact, case-sensitive AWS tag key. A filter list supports at most 50 keys.

values.title: Accepted values
values.description: Accepted values for this key, 1 to 20, exact and case-sensitive. Any of them matches.

query.title: Query policy
query.description: Query timing overrides for this rule. Fields left empty inherit the rule defaults; group and metric values take precedence.

period.title: Aggregation period
period.description: CloudWatch aggregation period for these series, from `1m` to `24h` in whole minutes.

lookback.title: Rolling lookback
lookback.description: Window searched for the newest datapoint. At least one period, a whole multiple of it, and at most 1,440 periods.

publication_delay.title: Publication delay
publication_delay.description: How long to wait after a period closes before querying it. A scheduling policy, not an AWS guarantee. Use `0s` only for metrics that publish immediately.

rule_defaults.title: Rule defaults
rule_defaults.description: Job-wide defaults inherited by collection rules that do not replace them.

filters.title: Resource filters

resource_tags.title: Default AWS resource tag filters
resource_tags.description: Resource tag filters inherited by rules that define none. A resource must match every key, with any listed value per key.

key.title: AWS tag key
key.description: Exact, case-sensitive AWS tag key. A filter list supports at most 50 keys.

values.title: Accepted values
values.description: Accepted values for this key, 1 to 20, exact and case-sensitive. Any of them matches.

filters.description: Resource filters inherited by every rule that does not define its own.

query.title: Default query policy
query.description: Query timing inherited by every rule, field by field. Fields left empty fall back to profile or built-in values.

period.title: Aggregation period
period.description: Default CloudWatch aggregation period, from `1m` to `24h` in whole minutes. Rules, groups, and metrics may override it.

lookback.title: Rolling lookback
lookback.description: Default window searched for the newest datapoint. At least one period, a whole multiple of it, and at most 1,440 periods.

publication_delay.title: Publication delay
publication_delay.description: Default wait after a period closes before querying it. A scheduling policy, not an AWS guarantee.

labels.title: Resource labels
labels.description: Optional AWS resource tags copied to every matching Netdata chart as non-identity labels.

resource_tags.title: AWS resource tag labels

key.title: AWS tag key
key.description: Exact, case-sensitive AWS tag key to copy.

label.title: Netdata label
label.description: Netdata label key to use. Leave empty to derive it from the AWS key (`Name` becomes `name`).

resource_tags.description: AWS resource tags copied to charts as labels. Presentation only; they never select resources.

limits.title: Collection limits
limits.description: Operator safeguards that reject unexpectedly large compiled work without truncating collection.

max_instances.title: Maximum instances
max_instances.description: Maximum distinct resource instances that emit metrics. Exceeding it rejects the plan instead of collecting a subset.

max_discovery_groups.title: Maximum discovery groups
max_discovery_groups.description: Maximum target, region, and namespace combinations discovered per job, 1 to 100. Split larger collection across jobs.

discovery.title: Discovery

refresh_every.title: Refresh interval
refresh_every.description: How often to rediscover matching metrics and resources, in seconds.

recently_active_only.title: Recently active only
recently_active_only.description: Restrict discovery to metrics with activity in the last three hours, which keeps scans smaller and cheaper.

discovery.description: How often and how widely the collector scans CloudWatch for matching metrics.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout for each AWS API operation, in seconds. Discovery shares one timeout across a whole refresh.

update_every.ui:help: How often to collect CloudWatch metrics. CloudWatch metric periods are at least 60 seconds.

autodetection_retry.ui:help: How often to retry a failed job check. Set to `0` to disable retries.

timeout.ui:help: AWS operation timeout. Identity, resource-tag, and query operations use it for their operation scope; discovery shares one timeout across its whole refresh stage. Accepts decimals for sub-second granularity (for example, `0.5` for 500ms).

credentials.ui:help: Define one or more named credential sources. `default` uses the AWS SDK credential chain. `static` reveals a `type_static` section for explicit long-lived or temporary credentials. Reference these names from monitored targets.

name.ui:help: Referenced from the Targets tab. Names are lowercase, start with a letter, use only letters, digits, `_`, and `-`, and are at most 64 characters; target and rule names follow the same format.

type.ui:help: Choose how Netdata gets base AWS credentials: `default` uses the AWS SDK credential chain and `static` uses explicit long-lived or temporary credentials.

access_key_id.ui:help: AWS access key ID. Prefer a go.d secret reference.

secret_access_key.ui:help: AWS secret access key. Use a go.d secret reference instead of plaintext.

session_token.ui:help: Optional session token for temporary AWS credentials.

targets.ui:help: Define the AWS identities to monitor. Each target references one credential source and may use it to assume one IAM role.

name.ui:help: Stable target name referenced by collection rules.

role_arn.ui:help: IAM role assumed before collecting this target. Leave the Assume role section empty to use the base credentials directly.

external_id.ui:help: Optional external ID supplied by the role owner when required by the role trust policy.

rules.ui:help: Add ordered collection rules. The earliest matching rule and target own each overlapping exported metric/statistic series.

name.ui:help: Stable rule name used in validation and diagnostics.

targets.ui:help: Ordered target names collected by this rule.

profiles.ui:help: Choose which stock or user CloudWatch profiles this rule collects. Omit this section to use all default-enabled profiles. Detailed PrivateLink endpoint/service grains are opt-in. Billing is opt-in through billing_total, billing_service, billing_linked_account, and billing_linked_account_service.

defaults.ui:help: Include all default-enabled profiles before applying include and exclude lists.

include.ui:help: Additional profile basenames to include. PrivateLink detail choices are privatelink_endpoint_subnet, privatelink_service_az, privatelink_service_load_balancer, privatelink_service_az_load_balancer, and privatelink_service_vpc_endpoint. Billing choices are billing_total, billing_service, billing_linked_account, and billing_linked_account_service; use us-east-1 and disable inherited resource-tag filters for them.

exclude.ui:help: Profile basenames to remove from this rule's selection.

metrics.ui:help: Optional per-profile overrides. Omit this list to collect default-enabled metrics. Profiles without a group keep their defaults; each group can add opt-in metrics or switch to an exact-only set.

profile.ui:help: Profile basename already selected by this rule. Add each profile at most once; other selected profiles keep their default-enabled metrics.

defaults.ui:help: Keep this profile's default-enabled metrics before adding the MetricNames below. Disable for an exact-only selection.

statistics.ui:help: Optional AWS statistics inherited by included metrics. If both statistics lists are omitted, the profile-declared statistics are used.

query.ui:help: Override CloudWatch timing only for series expanded from this group's include list. Unlisted default-selected series keep rule/profile timing.

period.ui:help: Aggregation period for explicitly included series. Eligibility is still evaluated only on shared update_every ticks.

lookback.ui:help: Rolling window searched for the newest eligible datapoint.

publication_delay.ui:help: Collector wait after a period closes. This is not an AWS publication guarantee.

include.ui:help: Exact AWS MetricNames to add. A metric-level statistics list replaces the group list; if both are omitted, the profile-declared statistics are used. Repeat a MetricName only for disjoint statistics.

name.ui:help: Exact, case-sensitive AWS MetricName from the profile.

statistics.ui:help: Optional replacement statistics for this metric. Leave empty with no group statistics to inherit the profile declaration.

query.ui:help: Override CloudWatch timing for this item's expanded metric/statistic series. Omitted fields inherit the group, rule, and profile chain.

period.ui:help: CloudWatch aggregation period for this item. Execution remains quantized to update_every ticks.

lookback.ui:help: Rolling window searched for the newest eligible datapoint.

publication_delay.ui:help: Collector wait after a period closes. Explicit 0s is allowed.

regions.ui:help: AWS regions collected by this rule. Unsupported profile/region combinations are handled automatically.

filters.ui:help: Omit Resource tags to inherit the job default. A non-empty list replaces the default; an explicit empty list disables tag filtering for this rule.

resource_tags.ui:help: Exact, case-sensitive AWS tag predicates. All keys must match; any value listed for one key may match. Explicitly included profiles must support safe resource-tag association.

values.ui:help: Accepted exact values for this key.

query.ui:help: Override CloudWatch timing for this rule. Omitted fields inherit rule defaults and profile values. A successful query may replay the newest eligible value for up to the lookback; transient failures may replay it longer.

period.ui:help: Aggregation period used by CloudWatch and for per-second rate normalization. Do not set it below the metric's real publication cadence: that adds billed queries and may produce empty windows.

lookback.ui:help: Rolling window searched for the newest eligible datapoint. Longer windows increase response work.

publication_delay.ui:help: Collector wait after a period closes before querying it. This is not an AWS publication guarantee.

rule_defaults.ui:help: Defaults inherited by rules that do not provide their own value.

resource_tags.ui:help: Default exact AWS resource tag predicates. All keys must match; any listed value may match for one key. Unsupported default-selected profiles are skipped and reported.

key.ui:help: Exact, case-sensitive AWS resource tag key.

values.ui:help: Accepted exact, case-sensitive values for this key.

query.ui:help: Shared query timing inherited field-by-field by collection rules.

period.ui:help: Default aggregation period inherited by rules. Do not set it below participating metrics' real publication cadence: that adds billed queries and may produce empty windows.

lookback.ui:help: Default rolling window inherited by rules. A successful query can present an old CloudWatch value as current for up to this lookback; transient failures can replay it longer. Longer windows also increase response work.

publication_delay.ui:help: Default collector wait inherited by every rule that omits it. This overrides profile-specific delays, including the stock S3 storage profile's conservative 1d policy. AWS documents that S3 storage metrics are reported once per day, but does not guarantee publication within one day. Use a shorter default only after verifying every inheriting workload.

resource_tags.ui:help: Copy selected AWS tags to Netdata chart labels. This affects presentation only and does not select resources.

label.ui:help: Optional Netdata label key. Leave empty to normalize the AWS tag key automatically.

max_instances.ui:help: Maximum distinct final resource instances that emit at least one selected series after filtering and overlap resolution. Raise this only for an intentionally larger job.

max_discovery_groups.ui:help: Safeguard for unique target, region, and namespace discovery groups. Compatible rules and profiles share groups. The default 64 is intended to catch accidental expansion; the hard maximum is 100 because every group needs at least one ListMetrics operation in the bounded refresh. Split larger collection across jobs.

refresh_every.ui:help: How often to rediscover matching CloudWatch metrics and resources.

recently_active_only.ui:help: When enabled, use CloudWatch's three-hour filter only when every selected series sharing a namespace scan has publication_delay + lookback + period of three hours or less. A longer-horizon participant keeps the shared scan unfiltered.

vnode.ui:help: Optional virtual node name used to group all charts from this job under a specific Netdata virtual node.
vnode.ui:placeholder: To use this option, first create a Virtual Node and then reference its name here.
